# AGENTS.md

## FVM (Flutter Version Management)

This repo uses FVM pinned to Flutter SDK **2.10.3** (see `.fvm/fvm_config.json`).
Prefix all flutter/dart commands with `fvm`:

```
fvm flutter test
fvm flutter analyze
fvm flutter pub get
fvm dart run util/lib/main.dart
```

## Key concept: auto-generated icon file

`lib/font_awesome_flutter.dart` (~81k lines) is **automatically generated** -- do NOT edit it manually.
The header comment `// THIS FILE IS AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED!` marks this.

To regenerate it, use the configurator in `util/`:

```
./util/configurator.sh
```

The configurator (`util/lib/main.dart`) reads Font Awesome icon metadata (`lib/fonts/icons.json`),
filters by style, and writes `lib/font_awesome_flutter.dart`.

## Architecture

Single-package layout (not a monorepo):

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `lib/src/fa_icon.dart` | `FaIcon` widget -- non-Material replacement for Flutter's `Icon` that does NOT wrap in a fixed square |
| `lib/src/icon_data.dart` | Per-style `IconData` subclasses (`IconDataSolid`, `IconDataBrands`, etc.) |
| `lib/font_awesome_flutter.dart` | Generated `FontAwesomeIcons` class with all icon constants (FA 6.2.1) |
| `lib/fonts/` | `.ttf` font assets registered in `pubspec.yaml` |
| `util/lib/main.dart` | CLI code generator (dart script, not flutter) |
| `example/` | Reference Flutter app consuming the package via path dependency |

## Build, test, lint

```bash
fvm flutter pub get                   # install dependencies
fvm flutter analyze                   # static analysis / lint
fvm flutter test                      # all tests
fvm flutter test test/fa_icon_test.dart  # single test file
```

No CI workflows are configured in this repo.

## Notable constraints

- **Dart 2.x only**: SDK constraint `>=2.12.0 <3.0.0`. This is pre-Dart-3.
- **Lints**: `flutter_lints ^1.0.0`, default Flutter lint set via `analysis_options.yaml`.
- The package ships 5 font families (Brands, Light, Regular, Solid, Thin). `IconDataDuotone` exists in code but is not registered in `pubspec.yaml` fonts.
- Font Awesome Pro styles (Light, Thin, Duotone) require Pro font files to be installed.
